issues.reason: The official AM assertion says criminal liability arises when the accident causes injuries of any severity, but its printed verdict is FALSO. Article 590 also covers negligent personal injuries without restricting them to serious injuries, while article 590-bis covers serious or very serious road injuries. The question does not specify whether it is asserting automatic liability without the required fault or other elements; reading that omission as a denial of those conditions is not established. Independent adjudication is needed to resolve the printed verdict without incorrectly teaching that minor injuries cannot give rise to criminal liability.

issues: 27313: The explanation says assistance does not erase liability for “the offence that caused the accident.” The relevant offence may be negligent injury caused by the accident, rather than an offence causing the accident. State that assistance does not automatically eliminate liability arising from the accident, without reversing the causal relationship.
